observations.silhouettePredicate: R > 130 and G < 100 and B < 130 in an owned red-on-white slide
observations.scope: Actual background-opened WPS canvases. Pixel-center bounding observations include screenshot resampling, antialiasing and subpixel placement; they are not exact vector boundaries or a visual acceptance tolerance. No PowerPoint or edit-roundtrip result.

findings: Changing only integer path coordinate units preserves exact native pixel tiles and causes no unit-multiplier-sized WPS difference in the observed canvases.
WPS shows intermediate truncated joins in a fixed-width limit series. Changing a scalar limit in a full-miter-or-bevel backend cannot express those intermediate shapes.
Pen-width and angle studies require further target-profile investigation; no universal coefficient or WPS-internal algorithm is inferred.
scope: Owned native PPTX and actual WPS canvas investigation. No production geometry rewrite, acceptance-threshold relaxation, performance/size improvement or complete compatibility claim.
